description: vLLM is a high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible API, using PagedAttention for fast batched serving.
name: vllm
note: Requires an NVIDIA GPU. Attach a GPU to this container under Portainer's Runtime & Resources tab after creation (the equivalent of docker run --gpus all), and ensure the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is installed on the host.
title: vLLM
